meta.title: Add paste summarization to Codex TUI
meta.body_summary: Adds paste handling to Codex TUI: collapses large pasted blocks to a placeholder like '[Pasted Content X characters]' while storing full text for submission, avoiding per-character processing overhead.

perf_labels.notes: OpenAI_Codex added paste summarization in TUI; reviewer requested higher threshold; after fix, merged within a day.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 710 changed lines, this is a medium-sized feature by absolute volume, concentrated in chat_composer.rs. As a UI performance PR it merged smoothly after one review round with minor threshold adjustment.

review_details.concern_detail: Reviewer bolinfest suggested increasing paste summarization threshold from 100 to 500 or 1000 chars to avoid frustrating users who might want to edit pasted text before submitting, and noted a leading 't' in a test snapshot output.
review_details.performance_claim: Replace per-character paste processing with a Paste event and collapse large pastes into a placeholder to reduce UI overhead.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Implementing paste summarization in a TUI requires understanding of terminal event handling and Ratatui/Crossterm APIs; the agent demonstrated this capability with tests and snapshots, with review focused on UX threshold tuning.

detection_detail.code_reading: Reviewer examined paste threshold constant and test snapshot output, requesting changes before merge.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No before/after performance measurements, but unit tests and snapshots verify behavior.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: Increased threshold to 500 and added more test scenarios after review feedback.

core_change_summary.description: Introduced Paste event handling to replace per-character paste processing in TUI; when pasted text exceeds a character threshold, it is replaced with a placeholder like '[Pasted Content X characters]' while retaining full text for submission. Implemented across App, ChatWidget, BottomPane, and ChatComposer. Added test snapshots and multiple paste/deletion scenarios.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Snapshots test empty, small, large, multiple paste, and backspace after paste scenarios.
change_trajectory: Initial commit: basic paste placeholder logic and wiring (chat_composer.rs, app.rs, etc.).
Add tests and snapshots for empty, small, large pastes.
Fix deprecated terminal API in tests.
Increase threshold to 500 and add more tests (multiple pastes, backspace).

review_signals.summary: Approved but requested increasing paste threshold and questioned leading 't' in snapshot.
review_signals.action_taken: Author increased threshold to 500 and updated tests.

review_signals.summary: 100 chars too low; suggested 500 or 1000 to avoid frustrating users who want to edit pasted text.
review_signals.action_taken: Threshold increased to 500 in follow-up commit.

review_signals.summary: Questioned leading 't' in snapshot output string.

~13h later, reviewer approves with comments about threshold and snapshot artifact.
Within ~4h, author increases threshold, adds more tests, and merges same day.
